name: Gecko Robotics
h1_tail: Funding Rounds, Share Prices and Ownership
description: Gecko Robotics is privately held and has no ticker. Review the price of each funding round, the investors and SPVs that hold its shares, and the points to confirm before buying or selling.
ledes: Gecko Robotics is a privately held industrial robotics and software company. Its shares are not listed on an exchange and have no quoted market price; the principal public reference points are the prices at which the company has raised capital. Its most recent financing, a $125 million Series D round announced on June 12, 2025, valued the company at $1.25 billion.

Founded in 2013 and based in Pittsburgh, Gecko Robotics builds robots that climb and inspect boilers, tanks, pipelines and other industrial equipment, together with software that analyzes the data they collect. Existing shares change hands in privately negotiated transactions, frequently through special purpose vehicles, and remain subject to the company's transfer restrictions.

table_note: Valuations are as reported at the time of each round. Gecko Robotics did not state a valuation for the Series C extension; the figure shown is as reported by CNBC.
round_notes: Cox Enterprises led the Series D. The December 2023 extension brought the Series C to $173 million in total.

A round price reflects what investors paid for the preferred stock issued in that round. Most shares sold by employees are common stock, which carries fewer rights and typically trades at a discount to the preferred price.
investors: Cox Enterprises led the Series D, joined by existing investors including the U.S. Innovative Technology Fund, XN, Founders Fund and Y Combinator. Founders Fund and the U.S. Innovative Technology Fund co-led the December 2023 extension of the Series C, which XN had led in March 2022. Other investors include Drive Capital, Snowpoint Ventures, Joe Lonsdale and Mark Cuban.
spv_sentence: Since 2022, eight special purpose vehicles formed to invest in Gecko Robotics have filed with the SEC, one of them in 2026.
sources: Sources: Gecko Robotics' announcement of its Series C extension, dated December 5, 2023; reports by CNBC (June 12, 2025), SiliconANGLE (June 2025 and December 2023) and Robotics 24/7 (March 2022); and SEC Form D filings.
